basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to own one of the few 3 bedroom water view residences in Tower II at The BRANNAN. Stunning Unobstructed Panoramic Views of the Water & Bridge. This highly coveted A-floor plan unit on the 10th floor offers 3 bedrooms + 3 full bathrooms. All rooms offer panoramic views of the Water, iconic Bay Bridge and Downtown Skyline. Gorgeous brand new white oak hardwood flooring throughout the entire unit. Unit 10A has an open floor plan featuring a spacious living room with stunning water & bridge views. Large primary suite with an exclusive-use outdoor terrace, perfect for soaking in the views. Both guest bedrooms are spacious with one offering an on suite bathroom. The Brannan's interior was designed by French Interior Designer Christian Liaigre and inspired by the historic SF Waterfront. The Brannan offers a full service of luxury amenities that include 24-hr security, a door person in each tower, heated 75 ft. lap pool, jacuzzi, gym/fitness center, concierge services, spa & BBQ area and 1 car parking. Located 1 block from the Embarcadero Waterfront, close to Ferry Building Plaza, Farmers Market, Oracle Park (Giants), Chase Center (Warriors), Caltrain, shops, world-class restaurants and close to all forms of transportation.
